title: 第一卷 第5章 橡胶树 再一次升级
slug: 木屋求生一天一个神级特性
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

很好，有了这个东西，至少各个方面要方便很多了。

除了这些，木屋里面的空间也是比之前的大上了不少。

这就是升级之后的一级木屋，给人感觉安全感增加了不少。

想了想，秦龙将刚才打丧尸的木棍在简易制作台上面加工了一下。

木棍的一端，被做成了一个尖刺形状的。

既没有太过尖刺，也不会太过钝刃。

一个简易的木制长枪。

用来捅丧尸脑袋再合适不过了。

刚才就发现了，杀丧尸这种东西，用这种长棍去捅，远比近身去搏斗要安全一点省力一点！

看了一下木屋升级到二级的条件。

一百块木板、五块橡胶

木板翻了一倍，算是中规中矩。

可这个橡胶是用来做什么的。

再说了，这荒山野岭的，上哪里去整橡胶？

看了一下交易平台。

上面还真有把橡胶拿出来交易的。

橡胶一块，交易吃的或者喝的。

也就只有这么一块。

秦龙立马联系这个卖家。

“兄弟，橡胶我要了，我这里有一桶泡面，可以吧！”

消息发出去，几乎是秒回，看来这个家伙确实是有点饿了。

“可以，太可以了，现在就交易！”

秦龙将脚汗酸菜泡面给放上去了，确定交易，瞬间交易完成。

一块巴掌大的橡胶凭空出现在了空间里面。

“兄弟，劳驾问一下，这个橡胶你是从哪里弄到的，不白问，我给你一块木板作为交换！”

“我艹，怎么是脚汗酸菜泡面，这特么能吃吗？算了，填饱肚子要紧！”

那边看到是脚汗酸菜泡面，显然也是犹豫了一下。

“兄弟，我开门出现的地方，是一个荒废的村庄，村庄里面有很多丧尸，我没敢进去。”

“就在村口的位置，有一个手推车的破轮胎，我收取以后就变成了橡胶，对了，木板子给我发过来......”

秦龙听完，将一块木板交易了过去，随后就关闭了聊天。

荒废的村庄，手推车破轮胎？

这不是全名爬山求生吗？

山里为什么会有荒废的村庄？

看来这个世界有很多东西需要慢慢探索了。

用一桶脚汗酸菜泡面，换到这么一个消息，也是比较划算。

透过门缝，观察了一下外面。

或许是自己一次性击杀了七八个丧尸。

这周围再没有丧尸出现。

背着木制长枪，手中提着石斧，秦龙再一次出门。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Very good, with this thing, at least all aspects will be much more convenient.

In addition to these, the space inside the wooden house is also much larger than before.

This is the upgraded first-class wooden house, which gives people a much greater sense of security.

After thinking about it, Qin Long processed the wooden stick he had just used to fight zombies on the simple making table.

One end of the stick was made into a spike shape.

Not too sharp, not too dull.

A simple wooden spear.

Perfect for poking zombies in the head.

I just discovered that when killing zombies, using a long stick to poke them is much safer and less labor-intensive than fighting at close range!

I took a look at the conditions for upgrading the wooden house to Grade II.

One hundred pieces of wood and five pieces of rubber

The wooden planks have doubled, which is quite satisfactory.

But what is this rubber used for?

Besides, where can I get rubber trimmed in this barren mountain?

Take a look at the trading platform.

There are people who actually take out the rubber and trade it.

A piece of rubber, traded for food or drink.

There is only one piece.

Qin Long immediately contacted the seller.

"Brother, I want the rubber. I have a bucket of instant noodles here, okay!"

After the message was sent, it came back almost instantly. It seemed that this guy was indeed a little hungry.

"Okay, that's great, let's trade now!"

Qin Long put the sweaty pickled cabbage instant noodles on top, confirmed the transaction, and the transaction was completed instantly.

A piece of rubber as big as a palm appeared in the space out of thin air.

"Brother, please ask, where did you get this rubber? If you ask, I will give you a piece of wood in exchange!"

"Holy shit, why are my feet sweaty and pickled cabbage instant noodles? Is this really edible? Forget it, it's important to fill your stomach!"

I saw the pickled cabbage instant noodles over there, and I obviously hesitated for a moment.

"Brother, the place where I opened the door and appeared was an abandoned village. There were many zombies in the village, and I didn't dare to go in."

"Right at the entrance of the village, there is a broken tire from a trolley. I collected it and turned it into rubber. By the way, send me the wooden board..."

After listening, Qin Long traded a piece of wood and then closed the chat.

Abandoned village, wheelbarrows with worn tires?

Isn’t this the full name of climbing a mountain to survive?

Why are there abandoned villages in the mountains?

It seems that there are many things in this world that need to be slowly explored.

It is more cost-effective to exchange a bucket of foot sweat sauerkraut instant noodles for such news.

He looked outside through the crack in the door.

Maybe he killed seven or eight zombies at once.

There are no more zombies around here.

Carrying a wooden spear on his back and a stone ax in his hand, Qin Long went out again.
